Excited to share that Senyo Aidam & I have officially closed our SEIS pre-seed round for Ayaa Botanicals! 

Thanks for everyone that gave us advice and support on the process.

Couldn’t be more thrilled about the incredible angel investors we have on board. 

Also pleased to say the funds are already working. 

Since receiving the investment we’ve been able to: finalise our product testing and plan our first manufacturing run; complete our branding hand in hand with our emerging community working with an incredible partner agency; and, whilst I’m quite proud of having built the website in stealth mode over the last year or so, I’m relieved to be passing the baton to designers for the finishing touches!
